manual_checks.description: Review auth, shared empty/error/loading states, groups registry rows and compact filter controls at 390x844, 420x912, 440x956, 912x420, 956x440, 768x1024 and 1440x1200; confirm hierarchy, long Russian wrapping, numeric alignment and no unintended horizontal overflow.
On Simulator or physical iPhone, confirm Safari chrome, safe-area, home indicator and software-keyboard behavior for representative forms before claiming device-level acceptance.
